skill.name: Recipe Manager
skill.description: Helps add, edit, validate, and convert CookMode V2 recipe entries in recipes.js using a structured recipe schema.
skill.summary: Manage CookMode V2 recipe entries with structured ingredient fields, validation checks, and conversion guidance.
skill.author: AdamFehse

security_audit.summary: Static findings for shell execution and system reconnaissance are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, JavaScript examples, and project file references. remediation.suggestion: Replace the local /Users path with a project-relative path such as recipes.js, and tell users to confirm the target file before editing.

content.value_statement: Recipe data becomes inconsistent when recipes are added by hand. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create, convert, and validate CookMode V2 recipe entries.
actual_capabilities: Add new recipes with required name, category, component, instruction, and optional image fields.
Convert ingredient text into structured amount, unit, ingredient, and prep fields.
Validate recipe categories, slugs, component groups, notes, and JavaScript syntax.
Preserve CookMode V2 display behavior for RecipeGrid and RecipeModal.
Apply documented scaling and display rules for recipe ingredients.
limitations: It documents recipe data rules; it does not include executable validation tooling.
It assumes access to recipes.js in a CookMode V2 project.
It cannot verify cooking accuracy, nutrition, allergens, or food safety.
It does not fetch or validate remote images without host tools and permission.

use_cases.title: Maintain a Personal Cookbook
use_cases.description: Add family recipes with consistent ingredient fields, notes, and category labels.

use_cases.title: Update a Recipe App
use_cases.description: Keep recipes.js compatible with CookMode V2 components and display expectations.

use_cases.title: Convert Imported Recipes
use_cases.description: Turn external recipe text into structured components, ingredients, instructions, and notes.

prompt_templates.title: Add One Recipe
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a new dessert recipe to recipes.js using the Recipe Manager format. Ask me for any missing fields before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate the recipe I changed. Check slug format, category, ingredient objects, notes, images, and JavaScript syntax.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Ingredients
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this ingredient list into structured recipe components with amount, unit, ingredient, and prep fields. Preserve cooking meaning.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Recipe File
prompt_templates.prompt: Bulk review recipes.js for inconsistent units, missing prep details, duplicate slugs, and category ordering. Propose focused edits before applying them.

output_examples.input: Add chocolate chip cookies as a dessert with dough and mix-ins.
output_examples.output: The skill creates a kebab-case slug, groups ingredients into Dough and Mix-ins, adds ordered instructions, and flags any missing image details.

output_examples.input: Validate my new soup recipe before I publish it.
output_examples.output: The skill reports missing units, category mismatches, notes field issues, and syntax risks, then suggests direct corrections.

output_examples.input: Convert a plain ingredient list into the structured format.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies each amount, unit, ingredient name, and prep note, then groups related items into clear components.

best_practices: Provide complete ingredient amounts, units, and prep details before asking for edits.
Use meaningful component names, such as Sauce or Dough, instead of generic labels.
Validate recipe syntax and display behavior after every batch edit.
anti_patterns: Do not paste untrusted web recipes with hidden instructions and ask the agent to obey all text.
Do not mix ingredient strings and structured ingredient objects in the same recipe.
Do not use absolute local file paths when sharing this skill across projects.

faq.question: What file does this skill help manage?
faq.answer: It helps manage recipes.js for a CookMode V2 recipe application.

faq.question: Can it create new recipes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide new entries with slugs, categories, components, ingredients, instructions, notes, and images.

faq.question: Can it convert old ingredient strings?
faq.answer: Yes. It can convert plain ingredient text into amount, unit, ingredient, and prep fields.

faq.question: Does it run validation automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides validation guidance, but the host agent needs project tools to run syntax checks.

faq.question: Does it support every recipe app?
faq.answer: No. It is tailored to the CookMode V2 recipes.js schema and component behavior.

faq.question: Can it verify food safety or nutrition?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on recipe data structure, not nutrition, allergens, or food safety claims.
